perks.name: Gift of the Ley Lines
perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Void Kills within 5? seconds of each:
Spawns a Void Breach.

perks.name: Techeun's Foresight
perks.description: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
perks.exact:
On Void Breach Pickup:
Grants Techeun's Clairvoyance for 7 seconds.
The next Void Weapon Kill consumes Techeun's Clairvoyance to trigger a Potent Void Detonation.
Potent Void Detonation deals up to 173 [?] Damage over 5 meters.

On Techeun's Clairvoyance timer expiry:
Downgrades to Techeun's Foresight.
The next Void Weapon Kill consumes Techeun's Foresight to trigger a Void Detonation.
Void Detonation deals 87 [?] Damage over 3 meters.
